message.content: One of the most acclaimed movies released in 2020 was **“Parasite”** (though it premiered in 2019, it had a wide release in 2020). It won the Academy Award for Best Picture and is widely praised for its sharp social commentary, genre-blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you’re looking for a film that combines suspense, drama, and a critical look at class disparity, “Parasite” is a standout choice from that year.
